evidence: Final override matrix passed with zero findings and 45 explicit combination rejections.
Focused tests pin representative loud failures.

rationale: Every single-axis boundary is honored, but a small grid, direction, behind-seed relation, and requested trail profile can leave no valid placement. Explicit rejection is safer than silently violating an override.
summary: Some mixed exact overrides are geometrically infeasible.

evidence: Baseline override gate: 5,008 findings over 14,670 draws.

summary: Expose only exact controls recoverable from the returned grid.

evidence: 30/30 audited lessons covered all four codes and supported the query.

rationale: The command symbols are arbitrary; omitting a mapping branch permits wrong permutations to survive. The query repeats one demonstrated code on a new layout.

evidence: Primary census contains 300 behind-seed and 300 off-axis scenes.
Visual set shows both relations in every difficulty and all four directions.

summary: Marker position is not the direction rule.
